messages:
sasha: quick heads-up — ran HF->Redwood conversion for mosaic-7b-instruct (quant pipeline) and seeing weird token-id bucketing. chat outputs sometimes start with <pad> and the BOS id looks shifted.
ben: repro steps? which converter flags did you use?
sasha: command I used:
```
redwood-convert --from hf --model mosaic-7b-instruct \
  --tokenizer tokenizer.json --added-tokens added_tokens.json \
  --quantize int8 --out /redwood/models/mosaic-7b/converted
```
small snippet from added_tokens.json: 
```
[{"content":"","id":0,"special":"<pad>"}, {"content":"","id":1,"special":"<bos>"}, {"content":"","id":2,"special":"<eos>"}]
```
anita: two quick checks: 1) make sure config.json.vocab_size matches tokenizer vocab + added_tokens count, 2) check if your converter is using "overlay" vs "preserve_ids" for added_tokens. overlay can reassign ids based on insertion order.
sasha: confirmed vocab_size was 50260 in HF but tokenizer.json.vocab_size after merge dropped to 50258 during conversion. quick diff shows: before conversion BOS=1, EOS=2, PAD=0; after conversion BOS=3, EOS=2, PAD=0. so BOS incremented by 2.
ben: that explains the chat template mismatch — many of our chat templates expect BOS at id 1, so generation conditioning is off. can you paste a minimal example of tokenization for "Hi"?
sasha: log: `input: "Hi" -> tokens [3, 573, 1180]` (should be [1, 573, 1180]). generation started with token 0 sometimes which maps to <pad> and prints as blank prefix.
ci-bot: test/regressions/instr-qa-v3 failed on canary: accuracy -14% vs baseline. failing samples show extra leading whitespace and missing system prompt separator.
anita: likely root cause: our HF->Redwood merge currently appends added_tokens then renumbers any duplicates, and quantization pass (int8) does an additional remap for efficient kv cache layout. sequence: overlay insert -> id shift -> quant remap -> final token id drift. two fixes: a) use converter flag `--added-tokens-strategy preserve_ids` to error on id collisions and keep explicit ids, b) update conversion to emit a token_map.json (explicit mapping) and feed it to quantizer to preserve logical ids.
ben: can you try workaround 1 (preserve_ids) and run a quick encode/ decode roundtrip plus the unit eval? I'll add a test for token_map sanity in the pipeline.
sasha: trying now. if preserve_ids errors, I'll attach offending added_tokens entries. also we should scan models in onboarding queue for any added_tokens with implicit ordering (no ids) — those are risky.
niro: i'll schedule a job to run token_map sanity across new HF imports and flag any with missing ids. thanks.
ben: note for follow-up: add a canary that runs a few chat templates and instr-qa quick eval after conversion+quant to catch regressions early.
sasha: thanks — will post results. for now pinning model to previous conversion and rolling back the canary.
notes: short thread — root issue: added_tokens overlay + quant remap caused BOS id to shift -> chat templates/regression. proposed fix: preserve_ids or emit token_map.json and feed into quantizer. follow-ups: pipeline test + batch scan for missing ids.
